content.scope: Existing SkillHub repair only: OAuth redirect, Vue production build and genuine local verification; no new business API or database schema.
implementation: Frontend copies approved package/lockfile, Vite/TypeScript and Prettier configs exactly; dependency bytes must match H1 hashes. Do not modify original tests or update dependencies.
Backend copies approved pom.xml exactly, fixes only AuthController.java, and runs its declared Spotless formatter.

Test Designer writes only specgate-tests.json and specgate-tests/. Its runner may temporarily copy its own supplemental tests to product test directories, removing only owned copies in finally; original tests and production code must remain unchanged.

Test Designer may reuse the audited runner safety fixes from commit 24d9865 and supplemental tests, but must freeze a new v1.9 manifest/fixtures and three genuine business cases; preserve history and original product tests. Reuse of old product commits remains subject to current white-list and exact dependency hashes.

testRunner.caseIds: Exactly CASE-CANARY19-AC-01, CASE-CANARY19-AC-02, CASE-CANARY19-AC-03. Each must genuinely fail under identical assertions before implementation. Auxiliary tool/history/selfchecks are mandatory setup constraints, not synthetic red business cases.
testRunner.green: Execute backend verify, all original and supplemental tests, Spotless check; frontend clean install with scripts disabled, build, tests with measured V8 coverage, lint and format:check; coverage reconciliation; actual isolated backend and built frontend HTTP checks. Save every real command, exit, timestamp and log. Record and terminate child process trees on every exit. Review, H3 and delivery are separate state-machine gates, not fabricated technical runner assertions.
testRunner.verificationField: The JSON case report must ALSO contain report.verification with the real measured quality report, for a server-owned evidence reader; this is not another model verdict.

verificationSchema.ok: true only after real successful stages
verificationSchema.v1Complete: true only after real successful stages
verificationSchema.status: verified only after real successful stages
verificationSchema.stages: Exactly one per expected stage: name, real numeric status, command, args, log, durationMs, startedAt, finishedAt. backend-verify and frontend-test include measured tests {total,passed,failed,skipped}. HTTP stages include measured response statuses, PID and actual termination. frontend-runtime includes html {status} and assets [{status,bytes,sha256}].
verificationSchema.reconciliation: {expected:9,executed:9,passed:9,failed:0,notRun:0} only if every stage actually ran successfully; retain real failures otherwise.

coverage.instructions: Generate supplemental frozen tests to reach actual thresholds. Never manufacture counters, narrow business source scope to game coverage, weaken original assertions, or skip cases.

runtime.backend: Use backend/src/test/resources/application.yml and H2 test classpath; do not contact production PostgreSQL or genuine OAuth.
assertions: OAuth redirect observed without following external redirect
Serve actual built Vue HTML and fetch at least one referenced nonempty JS asset with HTTP 200
runtime.cleanup: Record PIDs and actual termination on success, failure and timeout.

完成后有哪些可观察、可验证的验收标准？
需要覆盖哪些失败、边界或兼容场景？
有哪些安全、性能或并发约束？

nonFunctionalRisks.suggestion: 始终逐项标NOT_RUN，写入最终客户包与风险。
nonFunctionalRisks.text: 真实生产数据库、外部OAuth和负载未验收。

restatement.text: 只恢复现有OAuth相对跳转，保留全部原后端测试并真实红转绿。
仅用批准配置修复生产构建，所有原前端测试、类型检查、lint和格式检查必须真实运行。
用相同断言证明旧业务缺陷存在与修复后九阶段、覆盖率、HTTP全部通过；辅助自检是前置约束，独立Review/H3/Delivery由后续门禁负责，不硬编码到测试结果中。

securityPerformanceConcurrencyRisks.suggestion: 沿用有界超时、127.0.0.1绑定及进程树终止证据，失败不宣称通过。
securityPerformanceConcurrencyRisks.text: 本地子进程与隔离HTTP运行可能超时或留下监听。

testBlindSpots.suggestion: 独立Test Designer只冻结3个可真实失败的业务case；增加无业务失败、工具缺失、报告过期负向自检；严格每case全红。
testBlindSpots.text: 既有v1.8曾混淆自检与业务AC，且存在硬编码红灯。

request.text: 继续完成用户授权的 SkillHub 真实 M6 金丝雀闭环。修正 v1.8 将已满足的工具自检和历史保留作为业务 AC、无法诚实全红的需求建模错误，恢复原始 OAuth 跳转、前端生产构建和真实本地端到端验证三个业务目标。工具链/运行器安全、自检、全量原测试、证据新鲜度、进程树清理、历史保留仍为强制约束；三个业务 case 必须在实现前真实失败、实现后以相同断言真实通过。保留已有依赖精确哈希批准和可复用产品提交，重新冻结测试、执行红基线、串行集成、九阶段质量、Formatter 后完整重跑、strict Review、真实 H3 和唯一提交 DeliveryRecord。不推送不部署，生产 PostgreSQL、真实外部 OAuth、负载性能标 NOT_RUN。候选全文位于 SpecGate 源仓库 docs/implementation/specgate-core-mvp-v2/13-canary-closure-correction.md，最终以本 Change H1 文档为准。

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/auth/github 返回302且Location严格等于 /oauth2/authorization/github；全部原后端119项及补充测试真实通过，0 fail/skip/cancel。

requirements.text: 修复现有 GET /api/auth/github 的开发机绝对跳转，返回相对同源 /oauth2/authorization/github；仅修改 AuthController.java 和精确批准的POM。完整保留原119项后端测试及补充测试，原 OAuth 断言在实现前须真实失败。

acceptanceCriteria.text: npm run build、原49项及补充测试、npm run lint、npm run format:check实际退出0，0 skip/cancel；实现前生产build应因原TypeScript配置缺陷真实失败。

requirements.text: 修复Vue生产构建，保留原49项前端测试及补充测试，生产类型检查继续执行。仅复制 .specgate/codex/evidence/proposed-config-v1.1 中获批frontend配置和原精确manifest/lockfile。不得修改原测试、弱化断言、更新依赖；两个tsconfig使用此前语义等价且通过Prettier的规范字节。

acceptanceCriteria.text: 同一固定提交九阶段9/9实际通过，原测试及补充测试完整运行无跳过，真实覆盖率达到行80%/分支70%/变更行90%；回环后端JSON查询200、OAuth同源302、前端HTML及非空JS资源200，有PID及实际终止证据。实现前原OAuth和前端build缺陷使该端到端断言真实失败；基础设施错误不能算有效红。

requirements.text: 在同一固定提交执行九阶段真实本地质量验证：backend-verify、frontend-install、frontend-build、frontend-test、frontend-lint、frontend-format、coverage、runtime、frontend-runtime。完整测量原Java/Vue/TS业务源和改动配置，行80%、分支70%、变更可执行行90%。H2测试配置启动后端，检查JSON查询、同源OAuth302和实际构建前端HTML/JS。运行器预检、自检、退出码传播、当前报告新鲜度、进程树清理和历史保留是强制运行约束；基础设施失败退出2并阻断，不能伪造业务红灯。每个业务case必须以red/green完全相同断言先真实失败后真实通过。运行隔离、仅回环、串行写入，原项目测试不得改动；生产PostgreSQL、真实GitHub OAuth、部署、负载性能NOT_RUN。严格Review、Formatter后全量质量、真实H3和DeliveryRecord由后续独立状态机门禁验证，不伪装为本技术case已执行的事实。

details.actualBehavior: 原始 OAuth redirect 断言和前端生产 build 失败；v1.8 把已满足的运行器/历史约束建为独立业务case，无法满足冻结MVP的每case全红规则，已正式取消保留。
details.expectedBehavior: 三个业务 case 在相同断言下真实红转绿，全部原后端119/前端49及补充测试、生产build、lint、format、覆盖率和回环HTTP通过；独立Review和H3后交付同一提交。
